sourceReview: Independent bounded SAF source review by security_review; device tests by implementing agent.
limitations: Single API36 x86_64 emulator only; physical Android and ARM64 unverified.
Microphone/camera and OS notification display not exercised.
Actual OS process death, Activity recreation, and slow/failing remote document writers require further device tests; lease invalidation and cancellation have host/source coverage.

This preserved version used a single uptime-based Handler delay; subsequent source fixes add elapsed deadline checks at lifecycle entry and short nonrenewing timer checks. These reports establish awake-emulator behavior only.
